title: Fix unsafe function call and weak RNG in Training/harness.py
description:
## Source
SonarQube static analysis audit (`Data/Pages/audits/ms-sonar-static-analysis-7-26-26.md`)

## Findings
- 1 unsafe function call in `MemorySmith.Training/harness.py` (L552) — Critical severity
- 2 instances of pseudorandom number generator usage in security-sensitive contexts (`harness.py` L590, L863)

## Impact
Unsafe function calls may allow arbitrary code execution or insecure operations. Weak RNG in security contexts is predictable and exploitable.

## Action Required
1. Replace the unsafe call with a safe alternative per SonarQube recommendation
2. Replace `random` module usage with `secrets.SystemRandom` or `os.urandom` for security-sensitive randomness

## Effort
~35min

## Priority
P0 — Security
